Simplify Your Notes, Amplify Your Care

Session Note AI generates session summaries in seconds, reduces documentation time, and keeps automation accurate and compliant – through the power of ethical, HIPAA-compliant AI.

Request A Demo

Do More, Stress Less

Cut non-billable hours without cutting corners. RethinkBH’s Session Note AI is the ABA session notes automation solution designed for clinical accuracy and efficiency. It transforms manual, time-consuming documentation into automated ABA progress note summaries using actual session data.

With real-time alerts to keep summaries in sync, RBTs and BCBAs can focus on care – not catching up.

Faster Summaries, Full Control

Looking for the best software for writing and storing ABA therapy session notes? Session Note AI goes beyond automation. It is proactive documentation intelligence for ABA providers.

Clinicians maintain full visibility and control over every summary and update, ensuring summary session notes stay accurate, compliant, and audit ready.

Built-In Transparency, Security, and Privacy

Session Note AI is fast, secure, and HIPAA-compliant by design, making it ideal for ABA therapy documentation.

Built on Azure OpenAI for enterprise-grade protection and aligned with ethical AI principles, it supports compliance in ABA and strengthens clinical judgment (but never replaces it).

Summaries That Work Hard–Without the Hard Work

  • Keeps documentation aligned with payor standards
  • Helps prevent costly errors, audit risks, and reimbursement delays
  • Frees clinicians from repetitive, time-consuming, manual work
  • Built on ethical AI to protect data and support compliance

Stay Current with Real-Time Alerts

Compliance shouldn’t depend on guesswork. Session Note AI helps prevent costly errors by keeping records in sync and teams aligned. Real-time alerts notify clinicians of session data changes, even after a note is completed. Session summaries stay audit-ready across both in-person and telehealth ABA documentation workflows.

Maintain Compliance and Protect Revenue

Insufficient documentation is one of the leading causes of payor recoupments. Session Note AI helps prevent costly errors by keeping every session accurate and payor-ready, so you can safeguard compliance and reclaim time for care.

What People Are Saying

The new AI-generated session summaries have been a game changer for our RBTs. It has streamlined documentation and given our team more time to focus on meaningful client interactions.

Trevor Reagan

Practice Manager

at KidsChoice Therapy & Play Center
